decode.predictor: EdgeMoE-style offline layer-to-layer transition calibration; batch aggregated
decode.promotion: physical slot role swap; no expert-weight D2D copy
decode.execution: ready-first, per-slot wait, no global H2D barrier
decode.communication: 1 metadata collective + 1 fused forward A2A + 1 return A2A

trigger_positions.T1: urgent H2D -> async forward A2A -> predictor/prefetch placement (preferred)

final_runtime_selection.objective: maximize stable realized LA TPOT gain while avoiding gain-only dominated runtimes

V1_OPT_NOPF_BARRIER.demand_h2d: after forward A2A, fully completes before compute

V2_OPT_PF_BARRIER.demand_h2d: residual demand fetch completes at global barrier before compute

V3_OPT_PF_OVERLAP.demand_h2d: urgent early-start after current controller; overlap with forward A2A and ready-first compute

tie_breaks: larger mean LA gain across B128/B256
final_runtime_selection.anti_gaming: reject GAIN_ONLY_DOMINATED variant if larger relative gain is caused by worse BR while absolute LA TPOT is materially dominated

return_format: one coalesced partial vector per token/rank packet
legacy_numerical_parity: owner permits reported numerical and token differences
